inventory.name: PredefinedColorSpace enum values "srgb-linear" and "display-p3-linear" (new in Chrome 155)
CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings.colorSpace — requesting a linear backing store via getContext('2d', settings) and reading it back with getContextAttributes()
ImageDataSettings.colorSpace / ImageData.colorSpace — constructing and reading pixel buffers in the linear spaces

notes: Enum-widening change on existing canvas surfaces — no new members, so the inventory is the two new enum values plus the two settings surfaces (2D context settings and ImageData settings) through which a page reaches them. All IDL is quoted verbatim from the HTML Standard fetched 2026-10-11, which already includes both linear values in the PredefinedColorSpace enum. Known limits preserved honestly on-page: BCD has no subfeature for the linear values (prerequisite colorSpace rows quoted instead and labelled); no shipping Safari version for the linear values is recorded in the sources read ('already implemented in WebKit' per the Intent); no Edge version recorded; whether Chrome 155 also accepts the linear values on the WebGL/WebGPU surfaces that reference the same enum is not stated in the sources read and is flagged as such rather than claimed.

outOfScope.name: alpha
outOfScope.rationale: CanvasRenderingContext2DSettings member quoted in the verbatim settings IDL as context; this feature changes only which colorSpace enum values are accepted, not alpha behavior.

outOfScope.name: desynchronized
outOfScope.rationale: Settings-dictionary member present in the verbatim IDL block for completeness of the quoted dictionary; unrelated to color spaces.

outOfScope.name: colorType
outOfScope.rationale: Companion CanvasColorType setting quoted verbatim and mentioned because 8-bit linear backing stores band in the dark range; its own enum ('unorm8', 'float16') predates this feature and is unchanged by it.

outOfScope.name: willReadFrequently
outOfScope.rationale: Settings-dictionary member present in the verbatim IDL block; unrelated to this enum-widening change.

outOfScope.name: pixelFormat
outOfScope.rationale: ImageDataSettings member quoted in the verbatim IDL; the ImageDataPixelFormat enum is a separate, pre-existing surface unchanged by this feature.
